We need retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need propose route using available building blocks.

Target: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We can think disconnections: amide bond formation between an aniline (methoxy phenyl amine) and a carboxylic acid (or acid chloride) of the heterocycle.

The heterocycle: c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N is a 1,2,4-triazine? Actually nnn ring with N substituents. It has an amide carbonyl attached to the triazine (C=O attached to N? Actually NC(=O)c2nnn(...). So the heterocycle is attached via carbonyl to the aniline.

Thus step 1: coupling of 4-methoxy aniline (or 4-methoxy-? Actually the aniline is attached at para? The SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)... )c1. That's anisidine (4-methoxyaniline). So we need anisidine (commercial). Search.

Let's search anisidine.
